commits_at_first_review.message:
feat(react): add onReady callback and containerProps to <Editor/>

onReady(editor) fires once after the editor is created, handing back the EditorAPI handle; containerProps forwards DOM attributes (className/style/id/data-*/aria-*) onto the root div. Uses an explicit containerProps field to avoid onChange collisions between EditorConfig and the div's own props.

feat(vue): mirror onReady callback and containerProps in <Editor/>

Matches the React binding's semantics so onReady timing and containerProps behave identically across frameworks.
docs: document <Editor/> onReady and containerProps; mark roadmap #4 in-progress
